description: Full record for one ISO standard by number ("27001") or reference ("ISO/IEC 27001:2022"): title, abstract, status, edition, publication date, ICS, committee, the supersession chain, the correct iso.org page, and a best-effort live price. The reliable lookup (resolves any standard via its catalogue id).

number.description: ISO number or reference, any form: "27001", "ISO 9001", "ISO-9001", "ISO9001", "ISO/IEC 42001", "ISO 9001:2015". (The `reference` arg is also accepted.)

name: get_standard
